body.statement: Fix \(\delta\in[0,1]\). Under \(\text{ass:reference-risk-positivity}\), every compatible value of \(\Psi_\omega\) is below one if and only if \(U_\delta(b,q,\omega)<1\), and every compatible value is above one if and only if \(L_\delta(b,q,\omega)>1\). Unity is compatible if and only if \(L_\delta(b,q,\omega)\leq1\leq U_\delta(b,q,\omega)\), and both strict sides are compatible if and only if \(L_\delta(b,q,\omega)<1<U_\delta(b,q,\omega)\). All assertions optimize one common \(x\) across periods.
body.justification: This is endpoint algebra that calibrates the substantive common-law separation theorem to the named ratio.
body.gap: The trichotomy is an implementation corollary of finite sharp endpoints and is not claimed as a root contribution.
body.consumer: A reporting routine can translate computed endpoints into below-unity, above-unity, unity-compatible, or two-sided labels.
